intro: Humanities & Social Sciences Alive is a digital education and research platform for courses, workshops, reading initiatives, publications, and collaborative inquiry across the humanities and social sciences.
vision: To help people understand the ultimate truth in life, Birth and Death, while becoming creative, critical, and aware of everything around us.
mission: To make learners aware of emerging global dynamics, the importance of being in the game, and the responsibility of doing the right thing in pursuit of social justice.

founder.name: Gunasingarajah Maheshwaralingam
founder.role: Academic staff member, University of Peradeniya
founder.summary: The founder is interested in the humanities and social sciences, critical thinking, social justice, language learning, and the uneasy space between idealism and realism.

objectives: Provide accessible courses for students, professionals, and lifelong learners.
Support research literacy and collaborative humanities and social sciences projects.
Create workshops that strengthen communication, public speaking, and soft skills.
Build a professional digital presence ready for future LMS, payment, and publication modules.
Encourage learners to question inequality, injustice, global dynamics, and public life.

timeline.title: Public Website Launch
timeline.description: A premium public website introduces the platform, courses, research, workshops, events, and news.

timeline.title: Learning Portal
timeline.description: Student accounts, enrollments, lessons, certificates, and instructor tools connect through a Spring Boot backend.

timeline.title: Research Repository
timeline.description: Editors and researchers manage publications, downloads, reading clubs, and collaborative research initiatives.

timeline.title: Cloud Platform
timeline.description: Analytics, payments, notifications, and scalable cloud deployment prepare the system for wider public use.
